entry.title: 🚀 Introducing flexi-cache-node: A Modern, Zero-Dependency Replacement for node-cache
entry.summary:
Caching is one of those invisible building blocks that keeps applications fast, reliable, and efficient. If you’ve ever used node-cache, you know how handy it can be — but also how limited. That’s why I built flexi-cache-node : a zero-dependency, TypeScript-ready caching library for Node.js with modern features baked in. Why I built it 💡 I needed a cache that: could expire keys (TTL) reliably,
had LRU eviction so memory wouldn’t blow up,
supported tags so I could bulk-delete groups of keys,
could persist data to disk securely,
worked seamlessly in both JavaScript and TypeScript,
and most importantly… had zero dependencies.
